Title: Alarak Hotfix Patch
Subtitle: Hotfix 20.1.46446 (September 20, 2016), fixing a Sgt. Hammer Focused Attacks cooldown bug along with hotkey targeting and Alarak Home Screen menu issues.
Highlights: Hotfix 20.1.46446 (September 20, 2016), fixing a Sgt. Hammer Focused Attacks cooldown bug along with hotkey targeting and Alarak Home Screen menu issues.
CleanedNotes:
=== General ===
[Bug Fixes]
  • Repeatedly pressing an Ability hotkey in quick succession no longer cancels targeting mode.
  • Removed a stray toaster pastry from the far-left edge of the Alarak Home Screen on ultra-wide displays.

=== Heroes: Sgt. Hammer ===
[Bug Fixes]
  • Fixed an issue where each Basic Attack from Sgt. Hammer could reduce her Ability cooldowns multiple times after taking the Focused Attacks talent.
